  SELECT 
    school_name,
    department_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tip_material_key) AS unique_materials,
    COUNT(DISTINCT subject_id) AS num_courses,
    COUNT(*) AS total_material_records,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tip_material_status_key) AS distinct_material_statuses,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN has_any_price = 1 THEN tip_material_key END) AS materials_with_any_price
  FROM cleaned
  GROUP BY school_name, department_name
),
price_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    school_name,
    department_name,
    AVG(new_price) AS avg_new_shelf_price,
    AVG(used_price) AS avg_used_shelf_price
  FROM cleaned
  WHERE new_price IS NOT NULL OR used_price IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY school_name, department_name
),
merged AS (
  SELECT b.school_name,
         b.department_name,
         b.unique_materials,
         b.num_courses,
         p.avg_new_shelf_price,
         p.avg_used_shelf_price,
         b.total_material_records,
         b.distinct_material_statuses,
         b.materials_with_any_price,
         CASE WHEN b.unique_materials > 0 THEN 1.0 * b.materials_with_any_price / b.unique_materials END AS price_coverage_ratio
  FROM base_grp b

grand AS (

    SUM(total_material_records) AS total_material_records,
    SUM(distinct_material_statuses) AS distinct_material_statuses,
    SUM(materials_with_any_price) AS materials_with_any_price,
    AVG(price_coverage_ratio) AS price_coverage_ratio
  FROM merged
)

import pandas as pd

join_sql = '''
WITH base AS (
  SELECT d.subject_id,
         d.tip_material_key,
         d.tip_material_status_key,
         d.term_code
  FROM materials_by_course d
  WHERE d.tip_material_key IS NOT NULL
    AND d.tip_material_key NOT LIKE 'N/ACourse has no materials%'
),
subj AS (
  SELECT s.subject_id,
         s.department_name,
         s.school_name
  FROM subject_dept_school s
),
stat AS (
  SELECT sl.tip_material_status_key,
         sl.tip_material_status
  FROM status_lookup sl
),
joined AS (
  SELECT subj.school_name,
         subj.department_name,
         b.subject_id,
         b.tip_material_key,
         b.tip_material_status_key
  FROM base b
  LEFT JOIN subj ON subj.subject_id = b.subject_id
)
SELECT * FROM joined
'''
